mapper.sql: SELECT q.request_id, q.round_item_id, q.request_material, q.sample_size, q.remark, q.status, q.dept_comment, q.finding_yn, q.confirmed_result, q.finding_detail, q.requested_by, q.requested_at, q.submitted_by, q.submitted_at, q.reviewed_by, q.reviewed_at, q.updated_by, q.updated_at, i.round_id, r.round_year, r.quarter, r.status AS round_status, c.seq_no, c.audit_area, c.audit_item, c.item_detail, c.audit_period, i.team_code, t.team_name, i.assignee_id, u.user_name AS assignee_name, i.inspection_result, i.inspection_detail, i.action_plan, i.planned_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evidence e WHERE e.owner_type = 'AUDIT_REQUEST' AND e.owner_id = q.request_id AND e.deleted_yn = 'N') AS evidence_count FROM audit_request q JOIN round_item i ON i.round_item_id = q.round_item_id JOIN audit_round r ON r.round_id = i.round_id JOIN checklist_item c ON c.item_id = i.checklist_item_id LEFT JOIN team t ON t.team_code = i.team_code LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = i.assignee_id
mapper.select: WHERE i.assignee_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.round_year DESC, r.quarter DESC, c.seq_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_request (round_item_id, request_material, sample_size, status, requested_by, requested_at, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{roundItemId}, #{requestMaterial}, #{sampleSize}, #{status}, #{requestedBy}, #{requestedAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_request SET remark = #{remark}, status = #{status}, submitted_by = #{submittedBy}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE request_id = #{requestId}

UPDATE audit_request SET status = #{status}, dept_comment = #{deptComment}, finding_yn = #{findingYn}, confirmed_result = #{confirmedResult}, finding_detail = #{findingDetail}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE request_id = #{requestId}

UPDATE audit_round SET status = 'DONE', completed_by = #{completedBy}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_by = #{completedBy}, updated_at = #{completedAt} WHERE round_id = #{roundId} AND status = 'SUBMITTED'
